children.text: There are three ways for Georgian citizens to obtain a visa to travel to Zambia:
Visa on arrival
– the visa can be obtained upon arrival at the airport in Zambia.
Consulate visit
– the visa can be obtained by visiting the consulate and submitting the required documentation.
Electronic visa
– for short-term tourist visits, an electronic visa can be obtained.
The e-visa application is submitted on the Zambian government
website
, and the decision is made by the Zambia Department of Immigration. The same website is used to fill out the application form, upload documentation, and pay the visa fee.

page.title: How to apply for an e-visa?

children.text:
🔹 A detailed list of documents tailored to your travel purpose.
🔹 Completion of the application form.
🔹 Professional review of the documentation you provide.
🔹 Phone and online support.
🔹 Payment of the visa fee.
🔹 The highest standard of personal data protection.
Before the application is approved, the applicant must complete the following steps:

🔹 Fill out the application form.
🔹 Gather and upload the required documentation.
🔹 Pay the visa fee.
🔹 Receive the visa decision.
Processing of the Zambia visa application begins once the application is submitted, and takes 3 to 5 days.
The tourist e-visa is generally issued with a validity of 90 days and allows the applicant either a single entry or multiple entries into the country.

page.title: How long is the tourist visa valid?

children.text: A valid passport (valid for at least 6 more months)
Flight reservation
Proof of accommodation
Additional documentation (invitation letter, motivation letter, and others)
Make sure to include all required information in your application.
Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months from your planned return date.
Apply for your visa 1 month before your trip, as the immigration department handles a fairly high volume of applications.
It's important to remember, and not exceed, the rights and obligations granted by your visa category.

content.text: What determines whether I'll get a visa?

children.text: It's difficult to predict the likelihood of a specific applicant being granted a visa. However, it's clear that this depends on your close ties to your home country. Clear proof of your travel purpose is also important.

content.text: How do I check my visa status?

children.text: Nationals requiring visas on arrival or from Zambian Missions Abroad
– you can check your visa status at this link using your information.

content.text: Can the decision on a Zambia visa be guaranteed or challenged?

children.text: No one else can interfere with the consul's decision on issuing a visa. This decision is final. However, our qualified professionals will do everything possible to prepare your documents properly and in your favor for the consulate, so the consul fully understands your current circumstances and prospects, which increases the likelihood of the visa being granted.

content.text: How long does it take to receive the visa?

children.text: The visa is issued within 3 to 5 days after the documentation is uploaded.
